messages:
Alex W: Heads-up: planned maintenance for eu-central1 serving pool. Window: Tue 2026-04-14 02:00-04:00 UTC. Purpose: kernel + NIC firmware updates on a subset of GPU hosts and a controlled rolling drain.

Maria G: Are we expecting any customer-visible downtime?

oncall-bot: @channel Scheduled maintenance ticket created: MNT-2026-104. Notifying oncall and producing statuspage draft.

Alex W: Short answer: no full outage expected for hosted API, but there may be brief latency spikes (p95) for long-context requests during node drain. Dedicated customers with pinned capacity may see single-digit minute reconnections if their pinned host is rebooted; we should message those customers directly.

Jordan (SRE Lead): Plan: 1) Canary on 3 non-prod nodes for 20m. 2) Roll through serving pools with max 1% capacity offline at once. 3) Autoscaler fallbacks enabled to route traffic to other regions if needed. 4) Immediate rollback if error rate > 3x baseline or p99 latency > 2x baseline for 5m.

Maria G: What monitoring hooks should oncall watch?

Jordan (SRE Lead): Watch list: grafana/redwood/serving/p95_latency, p99_latency, error_rate(4xx/5xx), model_inference_time, queue_depth, and dedicated-connection-count. Run this query in grafana search: `job="serving" region="eu-central1"` then open the 1h trend.

Priya (Customer Ops): I'll draft a customer notice for impacted dedicated tenants. Draft below — please review: 

```
Subject: Upcoming maintenance in eu-central1 (Apr 14, 02:00-04:00 UTC)
Hi —
We are performing a brief maintenance window to apply stability updates to infrastructure in eu-central1. Hosted API customers should see no downtime; you may notice short latency blips during the window.

If you have dedicated capacity in eu-central1 (reserved pool), you may experience a connection refresh of a few minutes while we reboot hosts. We recommend:
- Pin non-critical workloads to another region for that window, or
- Notify your SREs to expect reconnects.

If you need assistance or want us to schedule a maintenance-free window, reply to this email and we'll coordinate.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Ops
```

Alex W: SGTM. Add a line about rollback and who to call for emergency SLA exceptions. Also add a link to the status page (Statuspage Bot will post final link).

Statuspage Bot: Draft statuspage message created: https://status.redwood.com/incident/MNT-2026-104. Suggested component: eu-central1-serving (Degraded Performance).

Maria G: Can we identify customers with pinned nodes in the affected pools? I can help send targeted DMs.

Jordan (SRE Lead): Yes — run `./tools/list_pinned_customers --region eu-central1 --pool serving-pool-3` — will output emails & account leads. I'll run immediately and hand results to Priya.

Priya (Customer Ops): Got the list from Jordan. I'll send the dedicated-cust draft and include an option to request a maintenance waiver.

Alex W: Oncall runbook reminders: 1) If p99 > rollback threshold, run `/run rollback-to-snapshot eu-central1 t-1` and notify #incidents. 2) If errors > threshold, enable fallback routing: `route-policy set eu-central1 fallback us-west1`. 3) Post updates to status page every 15m.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-04-13T23:00:00Z to ping oncall for final pre-check.

Jordan (SRE Lead): Post-maint checks: KV cache warmup for popular model prefixes, verify end-to-end inference via smoke-suite (3 models, 10 prompts each), and confirm no regression in BLEU/ROUGE for reranking pipelines used by customers.

Priya (Customer Ops): Customer email sent to pinned-tenants list (template + waiver link). Will post a short thread-per-customer for replies.

Statuspage Bot: Status page entry published (scheduled): https://status.redwood.com/incident/MNT-2026-104/scheduled-maintenance

Alex W: Thanks everyone. I'll post a short completion note in this thread once all hosts have been validated. Keep pings frequent during the window.

(Status update after maintenance)

Jordan (SRE Lead): 1991235020: Canary completed successfully. No regressions. Starting controlled rollout.

Jordan (SRE Lead): 1991235100: Rollout complete. All patched hosts passed smoke tests. No customer-facing incidents observed.

Priya (Customer Ops): 1991235140: Sent completion notice to pinned customers and updated tickets with remediation details.

Statuspage Bot: 1991235178: Maintenance completed. Component status for eu-central1-serving set to Operational. Link: https://status.redwood.com/incident/MNT-2026-104/complete

Alex W: 1991235178: Closing thread. Post-mortem: none required; will include small note in weekly ops update about shorter-than-expected warmup times.
